title: Auto Drive staging
description: Health of the Auto Drive staging stack on Chronos: its four hosts, the nodes, the DAG index, the backups and the backend processes. Built from the host agents' metrics, the containers' logs and the metrics the backends send

list.name: hosts
list.description: A pattern matching the four hosts

panels.title: Hosts reporting
panels.description: Staging hosts whose node_exporter answered its last scrape. 4 is all of them.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alerts firing for the staging hosts: RAID, SMART, full disks, boot code, a silent server, a scrape target down. No data means the Watchdog alert, which always fires, is absent, so vmalert is not reporting.

targets.expr: count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname!="Watchdog", host=~"${hosts:raw}"}) or (vector(0) and on() (count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname="Watchdog"}) > 0)) or vector(-1)

panels.title: Backend processes
panels.description: Backend processes that sent a sample in the last minute. 5 is all of them: the API, the worker and the publish worker on the private host, the download API and the download worker on the public host. A process samples only once it has used the database, so after a restart on a quiet host the APIs and the publish worker can be missing until they are used. Fewer than 5 is grey, as this cannot tell an idle process from a stopped one.

panels.title: Publish workers
panels.description: Publish workers running, inferred from the heartbeat rate: one writes 30 samples in 5 minutes, two write 60 to the same series. 0, grey, means no publish worker is sampling: none is running, or the one running has not published since it started, as it samples only once it has used the database; 2 or more means two publishers hand out the same nonces. This only holds while VictoriaMetrics keeps every sample: with -dedup.minScrapeInterval at 15s two read as one, and at 30s one reads as zero, so change this panel before turning deduplication on.

panels.title: API 5xx (15 min)
panels.description: API requests answered with a 5xx status in the last 15 minutes, across both backends. No data means no backend is sending its heartbeat.

panels.title: Pool waiting (5 min)
panels.description: The most requests any backend process had queued for a database connection in the last 5 minutes. Above 0, requests are waiting on Postgres. No data means no backend is sending its heartbeat.

panels.title: Parked uploads
panels.description: Uploads parked as failed in the last 24 hours because their migration could not be recovered. No data means the worker is not sending its heartbeat.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time(auto_drive_upload_migration_unrecoverable_count{chain="$chain"}[24h])) or (vector(0) and on() (count(count_over_time(auto_drive_runtime_pg_pool_total{chain="$chain", process="frontendWorker"}[5m])) > 0)) or vector(-1)

panels.title: Mesh traffic
panels.description: Staging hosts whose wg0 interface received traffic in the last 5 minutes. 4 is all of them. A proxy for the mesh: it shows wg0 receiving, not each peer answering.

panels.title: Silent services
panels.description: Of the archive node, the two farmers' nodes and the DAG indexer, which print a status line every 5 to 15 seconds, how many have printed none for 5 minutes. Only the status lines count, so a service stuck in a restart loop reads as silent.

targets.expr: (4 - count(sum by (host, compose_project, compose_service) (count_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project=~"file-retriever|subspace-farmer", compose_service=~"subspace-node|node|dag-indexer"} |~ `best: #|Host Status:` [5m])) > 0)) or vector(4)

panels.title: Archive: imported
panels.description: Blocks the gateway's archive node imported in the last 10 minutes, from its status line. 0 means it is stalled or down. About 100 at the tip, thousands while syncing.

targets.expr: max((max by (host, compose_project) (max_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="subspace-node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [10m])) - min by (host, compose_project) (min_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="subspace-node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [10m])))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Archive: behind
panels.description: Blocks between the archive node's best block and the tip its peers report. Above 0 it is still syncing; a stall shows on the tile beside this one. No data means the node has printed no status line for 5 minutes.

targets.expr: max(max by (host, compose_project) (last_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="subspace-node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `target=#(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [5m])) - max by (host, compose_project) (last_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="subspace-node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [5m]))) or (vector(0) and on() (sum(count_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="subspace-node"} |= `best: #` [5m])) > 0)) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: Farmers importing
panels.description: Farmers' nodes, on the gateway and the public backend, that imported at least one block in the last 10 minutes. 2 is both.

targets.expr: count((max by (host, compose_project) (max_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project="subspace-farmer", compose_service="node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [10m])) - min by (host, compose_project) (min_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project="subspace-farmer", compose_service="node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [10m]))) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: DAG behind
panels.description: Blocks between the DAG index and its target, the node's finalized head, which on Chronos trails the best block by about six days. Above 5 it is catching up, and 0 while it waits at its target. No data means the indexer has printed no status line for 5 minutes.

targets.expr: (max(last_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="dag-indexer"} |= "INDEXING:" | regexp `Target height: (?P<v>[0-9,]+)` | label_format v=`{{ .v | replace "," "" }}` | unwrap v [5m])) - max(last_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="dag-indexer"} |= "INDEXING:" | regexp `Current height: (?P<v>[0-9,]+)` | label_format v=`{{ .v | replace "," "" }}` | unwrap v [5m]))) or (vector(0) and on() (sum(count_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="dag-indexer"} |= `Host Status:` [5m])) > 0)) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: DAG stalled
panels.description: Blocks the DAG index is behind its target while not having advanced in 10 minutes. 0 means it is advancing, or at its target, where it moves a segment at a time. No data means the indexer has printed no progress line for 5 minutes.

targets.expr: (((max(last_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="dag-indexer"} |= "INDEXING:" | regexp `Target height: (?P<v>[0-9,]+)` | label_format v=`{{ .v | replace "," "" }}` | unwrap v [5m])) - max(last_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="dag-indexer"} |= "INDEXING:" | regexp `Current height: (?P<v>[0-9,]+)` | label_format v=`{{ .v | replace "," "" }}` | unwrap v [5m]))) > 5) unless ((max(max_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="dag-indexer"} |= "INDEXING:" | regexp `Current height: (?P<v>[0-9,]+)` | label_format v=`{{ .v | replace "," "" }}` | unwrap v [10m])) - min(min_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="dag-indexer"} |= "INDEXING:" | regexp `Current height: (?P<v>[0-9,]+)` | label_format v=`{{ .v | replace "," "" }}` | unwrap v [10m]))) > 0)) or (vector(0) and on() (sum(count_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="dag-indexer"} |= `INDEXING:` [5m])) > 0)) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: Backups (26 h)
panels.description: Backups of the gateway database that finished in the last 26 hours, counted from each run's success line. The timer runs nightly, and every deploy runs one too.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="gateway-db-backup"} |~ `^gateway-[0-9TZ]+: dag_height=` [26h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Errors (15 min)
panels.description: Log lines at error level or above from every container on the staging hosts in the last 15 minutes. No data means no line at all arrived from those hosts in 5 minutes.

options.content: **Not covered yet:** Hasura, nginx, the certificates, auth, RabbitMQ's queues and consumers, Postgres itself, the file retriever, and the public names from outside. Green above does not include them; `resources/terraform/auto-drive-staging/validate.sh` is the full check.

panels.title: Chain nodes
panels.description: One row per Subspace node, from the status line each prints every 5 seconds. Target is blank once a node is synced. A missing row means the node has printed nothing for 5 minutes.

targets.expr: max by (host, node) (last_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project=~"file-retriever|subspace-farmer", compose_service=~"subspace-node|node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else }}Farmer's node{{ end }}` | unwrap v [5m]))

max by (host, node) (last_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project=~"file-retriever|subspace-farmer", compose_service=~"subspace-node|node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `finalized #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else }}Farmer's node{{ end }}` | unwrap v [5m]))

max by (host, node) (last_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project=~"file-retriever|subspace-farmer", compose_service=~"subspace-node|node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `target=#(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else }}Farmer's node{{ end }}` | unwrap v [5m]))

(max by (host, node) (last_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project=~"file-retriever|subspace-farmer", compose_service=~"subspace-node|node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `target=#(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else }}Farmer's node{{ end }}` | unwrap v [5m])) - max by (host, node) (last_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project=~"file-retriever|subspace-farmer", compose_service=~"subspace-node|node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else }}Farmer's node{{ end }}` | unwrap v [5m]))) or (max by (host, node) (last_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project=~"file-retriever|subspace-farmer", compose_service=~"subspace-node|node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else }}Farmer's node{{ end }}` | unwrap v [5m])) * 0)

max by (host, node) (last_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project=~"file-retriever|subspace-farmer", compose_service=~"subspace-node|node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `\((?P<v>[0-9]+) peers\)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else }}Farmer's node{{ end }}` | unwrap v [5m]))

max by (host, node) (max_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project=~"file-retriever|subspace-farmer", compose_service=~"subspace-node|node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else }}Farmer's node{{ end }}` | unwrap v [10m])) - min by (host, node) (min_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project=~"file-retriever|subspace-farmer", compose_service=~"subspace-node|node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else }}Farmer's node{{ end }}` | unwrap v [10m]))

sum by (host, node) (count_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project=~"file-retriever|subspace-farmer", compose_service=~"subspace-node|node"} |= "best: #" |= "Syncing" | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else }}Farmer's node{{ end }}` [5m])) or (max by (host, node) (last_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project=~"file-retriever|subspace-farmer", compose_service=~"subspace-node|node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else }}Farmer's node{{ end }}` | unwrap v [5m])) * 0)

panels.title: Backend processes
panels.description: One row per backend process, from the samples each sends every 10 seconds once it has used the database. A process that has sent none for a minute keeps its row for a day, with Last sample grey: it may have stopped, or not have served anything that needs the database since it started, as the APIs and the publish worker can on a quiet host. Samples should be 30 for a process that is sampling; about 60, red, means two processes are running under one name.

panels.title: DAG index height
panels.description: The last height the DAG indexer reported: as it works through a finality step, and when it starts. Between steps it is idle and reports no height, so this holds where its last run ended.

targets.expr: max(last_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="dag-indexer"} |~ "INDEXING:|start guard: progress" | regexp `(?:Current height: |start guard: progress )(?P<v>[0-9,]+)` | label_format v=`{{ .v | replace "," "" }}` | unwrap v [3d])) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: DAG index target
panels.description: The height the DAG indexer works towards: the archive node's finalized head, from the node's log. Finality moves one archived segment at a time, every 10,000 to 20,000 blocks, so the index catches up in bursts and then waits.

targets.expr: max(last_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="subspace-node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `finalized #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [5m])) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: DAG index rate
panels.description: Blocks a second while the DAG indexer works through a finality step, as it reports it. Idle means it is running and has caught up with the finalized head; No data means it has logged nothing for 5 minutes.

targets.expr: max(last_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="dag-indexer"} |= "INDEXING:" | regexp `INDEXING: (?P<v>[0-9.]+) blocks/s` | unwrap v [5m])) or (sum(count_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="dag-indexer"} |= "Host Status:" [5m])) * 0 - 2) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: DSN peers
panels.description: DSN peers the RPC gateway is using, from the line it prints about every 5 minutes. Shown, not judged: it reads 0 while the gateway is idle. No data means it has not printed one for 15 minutes.

targets.expr: max(last_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="subspace-rpc-gateway"} |= "known peers" | regexp `actively using (?P<v>[0-9]+)/` | unwrap v [15m])) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: Newest backup
panels.description: When the newest backup of the gateway database finished, within the last 3 days.

targets.expr: max(last_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="gateway-db-backup"} |~ `^gateway-[0-9TZ]+: dag_height=` | label_format ts=`{{ unixEpoch __timestamp__ }}` | unwrap ts [3d])) * 1000

panels.title: Backup DAG height
panels.description: The DAG index height the newest backup recorded, which becomes the progress floor.

targets.expr: max(last_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="gateway-db-backup"} |~ `^gateway-[0-9TZ]+: dag_height=` | regexp `dag_height=(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [3d])) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: Set aside (26 h)
panels.description: Backups kept as suspect in the last 26 hours because the database was behind the last good backup's progress. No data means no backup run logged anything in 26 hours.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="gateway-db-backup"} |~ `^gateway-[0-9TZ]+ is behind the last backup` [26h])) or (vector(0) and on() (sum(count_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="gateway-db-backup"} [26h])) > 0)) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: Mapped segment
panels.description: The last archived segment the object-mapping indexer processed, within the last 3 days. It logs one each time the node archives a segment.

targets.expr: max(last_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="object-mapping-app"} |= "segmentIndex=" | regexp `segmentIndex=(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [3d])) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: Servers
panels.description: The staging hosts, as Fleet health shows them. Colours follow the alert rules' thresholds.

targets.expr: count by (host) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", host=~"${hosts:raw}"}) or count by (host) (up{host=~"${hosts:raw}"}) * 0

panels.title: Best block and target
panels.description: Each node's best block, and the tip it is syncing towards while it syncs.

targets.expr: max by (host, node) (last_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project=~"file-retriever|subspace-farmer", compose_service=~"subspace-node|node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else }}Farmer's node{{ end }}` | unwrap v [1m]))

max by (host, node) (last_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project=~"file-retriever|subspace-farmer", compose_service=~"subspace-node|node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `target=#(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else }}Farmer's node{{ end }}` | unwrap v [1m]))

max by (host, node) (last_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project=~"file-retriever|subspace-farmer", compose_service=~"subspace-node|node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `\((?P<v>[0-9]+) peers\)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else }}Farmer's node{{ end }}` | unwrap v [1m]))

panels.title: DAG index
panels.description: The DAG index's height against its target, the archive node's finalized head. Finality moves in steps, and the index follows each in a burst; its height holds between them.

targets.expr: max(last_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="dag-indexer"} |~ "INDEXING:|start guard: progress" | regexp `(?:Current height: |start guard: progress )(?P<v>[0-9,]+)` | label_format v=`{{ .v | replace "," "" }}` | unwrap v [1m]))
max(last_over_time({host="$gw", compose_project="file-retriever", compose_service="subspace-node"} |= "best: #" | regexp `finalized #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [1m]))

panels.title: Free space on /
panels.description: The farmers' nodes and farms share / with everything else; the farmer needs 50 GB free.

panels.title: Farmer rewards signed
panels.description: Reward hashes each farmer signed. A 1 GiB farm signs rarely.

targets.expr: sum by (host) (count_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project="subspace-farmer", compose_service="farmer"} |= "Successfully signed reward hash" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Backend connections to Postgres
panels.description: Each backend process's pool. Hasura and the gateway's apps connect too and are not counted.

panels.title: Event loop delay, p99
panels.description: How long each backend process's event loop was blocked.

panels.title: Database pool
panels.description: Each backend process's connections to Postgres, and requests waiting for one.

panels.title: Event loop delay, p99
panels.description: How long each backend process's event loop was blocked.

panels.title: Database pool
panels.description: Each backend process's connections to Postgres, and requests waiting for one.

panels.title: Interactions by type
panels.description: Uploads and downloads the backend recorded.

panels.title: Requests by path
panels.description: Requests the backends answered, both hosts together: the metric carries no host.
